limitations: Small targeted benchmark on CDL-labelled fields within spatially held-out HLS chips; not surveyed field boundaries.
No farmer-confirmed Sétif labels; regional transfer is unvalidated.
CDL fallow/idle is a satellite class, not a management record; no cereal/legume claims.
Only selected crop codes and fallow are scored; other land cover is ignored.
Fixed final training step; held-out results never select hyperparameters or checkpoints.
2022 HLS/CDL 30 m held-out accuracy 0.798733, fallow IoU 0.000000; compare the training-majority baseline in the validation report before use.
The small head upsamples 16-pixel (480 m) encoder patches to a 30 m output grid; pixel-sized field detail is not independently resolved.
2024–2025 transfer predictions; not validated against contemporaneous hero labels.
All seasons before 2024 lack six-band captures; no historical class maps synthesized.
